Alex Bregman [3-3, 2 BB, 3 HR | RC 67]'s three-homer explosion powered the Cubs to a 12-6 rout of the Nationals, trimming Chicago's deficit in the NL Central to 3.0 games as Milwaukee dropped a 4-3 decision to San Diego in the day's most dramatic game (5.37 WPA swing). The Cardinals also gained ground on the Brewers with a 7-1 win over Philadelphia.

  • Alex Bregman hit 3 home runs in the Cubs' 12-6 win at Washington, cutting Milwaukee's NL Central lead to 3.0 games. (CHC)
  • The Padres edged the Brewers 4-3 in a game featuring the day's largest WPA swing (5.37). (BREWERS)
  • The Cardinals cruised past the Phillies 7-1 behind a dominant outing, gaining ground in the NL Central while Philadelphia lost ground in the NL East. (PHILLIES)
  • Luis Castillo [7 IP, 0 ER, 10 K | 4.98 ERA, PAR 16] tossed 7 shutout innings with 10 strikeouts as the White Sox blanked the Reds 5-0. (CWS)
  • Trent Grisham [3-5, 2 HR | RC 46] homered twice as the Yankees rolled past the Mariners 10-5 at Yankee Stadium. (NYY)
  • The Rockies upset the Diamondbacks 6-4 in Arizona, costing the D-backs ground in the NL West while Colorado gained in the NL wild card race. (ROCKIES)
  • The Angels beat the Rangers 5-2, gaining a game in the AL wild card race behind Corey Seager [3-4, 1 HR | RC 27]'s 3-hit effort for Texas in the loss. (TEX)
  • The Twins, Guardians, and Blue Jays all won to gain ground in the AL wild card picture, defeating the Orioles, Tigers, and Red Sox respectively. (ORIOLES) (GUARDIANS) (SOX) (JAYS)

The NL Central race tightened dramatically as the leading Brewers lost 11-2 to San Diego while the Cubs, Cardinals, and Reds all won, with Chicago now just 4.0 games back. Meanwhile, Nick Martinez [9 IP, 4 ER, 5 K | 2.74 ERA, PAR 41] went the distance for Tampa Bay in a 12-4 rout of the Athletics.

  • Nick Martinez threw a complete game as the Rays blew out the Athletics 12-4. (TB)
  • The Cubs beat the Nationals 8-6 to pull within 4.0 games of Milwaukee in the NL Central. (CUBS)
  • The Padres crushed the Brewers 11-2, with Luis Campusano [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 25] homering to lead the offense. (SD)
  • Eury Pérez [7 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 3.41 ERA, PAR 32] tossed seven shutout innings as the Marlins blanked the Pirates 2-0. (MIA)
  • Blake Snell [6 IP, 1 ER, 10 K | 5.00 ERA, PAR 3] struck out 10 in the Dodgers' 5-4 win over the Royals, the day's most dramatic game by WPA swing. (LAD)
  • Cristopher Sánchez [6 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 2.55 ERA, PAR 59] was brilliant in defeat as the Cardinals shut out the Phillies 2-0 behind him being outdueled. (PHI)
  • The Rockies edged the Diamondbacks 3-2, gaining ground in the NL wild card race while Arizona lost ground in the NL West. (ROCKIES)
  • Pete Alonso [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 75] and Christian Encarnacion-Strand [3-4, 1 HR | RC 10] each homered as the Orioles beat the Twins 5-2. (BAL)

The New York Mets pulled within a game of momentum in the NL East race with an 8-5 win at Truist Park, joining Philadelphia, Washington, and Miami in chipping away at Atlanta's lead. Meanwhile, the Rays continued to look dominant, erupting for eight runs in the eighth inning to bury the Athletics 10-6.

  • Tampa Bay scored 8 runs in the 8th inning en route to a 10-6 win over the Athletics, with Yandy Díaz [3-4, 1 HR | RC 76] leading the charge. (TB)
  • Francisco Lindor [3-5, 1 HR | RC 35] homered as the Mets beat the Braves 8-5, cutting into Atlanta's NL East lead. (NYM)
  • The Phillies edged the Cardinals 6-5 to gain a game in the NL East, while dealing STL a blow in the NL wild card race. (PHILLIES)
  • Dean Kremer [7 IP, 1 ER, 7 K | 5.25 ERA, PAR 4] was dominant in Minnesota's 9-5 win over Baltimore, backed by a 4-for-5 day from Austin Martin [4-5, 1 HR | RC 33]. (MIN)
  • MacKenzie Gore [5.1 IP, 1 ER, 9 K | 4.43 ERA, PAR 28] struck out 9 as Texas beat the Angels 4-1, despite a homer from Mike Trout [1-2, 3 BB, 1 HR | RC 62]; the Rangers sit just 0.5 GB in the AL West. (TEX)
  • Cam Smith [3-4, 1 HR | RC 46] paced Houston to a 6-3 win over the Giants at Oracle Park, keeping the Astros atop the AL West. (HOU)
  • The Dodgers held off Kansas City 6-5, the Blue Jays edged Boston 2-1, and San Diego topped Milwaukee 3-2. (JAYS) (DODGERS)
  • Arizona blanked Colorado 9-0 at Chase Field.

Both NL West contenders gained a full game on the Dodgers, who lost at Arizona while San Diego handled Houston — tightening a division Los Angeles now leads by 7.5 over the Diamondbacks and 8.5 over the Padres. Philadelphia's one-run win over Toronto produced the day's biggest WPA swing at 5.64.

  • Kyle Schwarber [2-3, 3 BB, 2 HR | RC 82] and the Phillies edged the Blue Jays 7-6 in the day's most dramatic game, with Jesús Luzardo [7 IP, 2 ER, 12 K | 3.33 ERA, PAR 46] dominant on the mound. (PHI)
  • Arizona beat the Dodgers 4-2 and San Diego topped Houston 7-2, with both leaders — Los Angeles and Houston — losing ground. (DODGERS)
  • Pete Alonso [3-3, 2 BB, 2 HR | RC 72] powered Baltimore to a 10-5 win at Texas, gaining a game in the AL wild card race. (BAL)
  • Atlanta beat the Yankees 2-1 behind Cam Schlittler [7 IP, 1 ER, 11 K | 2.22 ERA, PAR 58]'s strong but losing effort; New York fell further back in the AL East. (NYY)
  • The Athletics stunned Boston 4-3 at Fenway, costing the Red Sox a game in the AL East. (ATHLETICS) (SOX)
  • The Mets routed Pittsburgh 11-1 as Sean Manaea [7 IP, 1 ER, 11 K | 4.15 ERA, PAR 21] dealt and Bo Bichette [5-5, 1 BB | RC 55] collected five hits. (NYM)
  • Milwaukee outlasted Minnesota 4-3, with Jake Bauers [2-3, 2 BB, 1 HR | RC 67] homering for the NL Central leaders. (MIL)
  • Detroit beat San Francisco 3-1 behind Logan Webb [8 IP, 1 ER, 2 K | 3.59 ERA, PAR 38]'s tough-luck start and Troy Melton [6 IP, 0 ER, 5 K | 1.46 ERA, PAR 31]'s scoreless outing, gaining a game in the AL wild card race. (SF)

Both NL East and AL West leaders lost ground Saturday, as Washington and Miami each pulled a game closer to Atlanta, while Texas closed to within a half-game of Houston in the AL West. The day's most dramatic finish came in Arizona, where the Dodgers edged the Diamondbacks 2-1 in a game with a 5.39 WPA swing to maintain their 8.5-game division lead.

  • The Dodgers beat the Diamondbacks 2-1 in the day's most dramatic game, dropping Arizona further back in the NL West. (DODGERS)
  • The Blue Jays outlasted the Phillies 7-5 in Philadelphia in another high-swing contest. (JAYS)
  • Sandy Alcantara [7 IP, 0 ER, 8 K | 3.53 ERA, PAR 42] dominated as the Marlins shut out the Angels 7-0, gaining ground on Atlanta in the NL East. (MIA)
  • The Nationals routed the Reds 8-2 behind a strong offensive showing, also gaining on the Braves. (BRAVES) (REDS)
  • The Rangers beat the Orioles 5-1 to pull within a half-game of Houston, who fell 3-2 to the Padres on Michael King [6 IP, 1 ER, 6 K | 3.37 ERA, PAR 34]'s strong start. (SD)
  • Jac Caglianone [4-4, 2 HR | RC 60] went 4-for-4 with 2 HR as the Royals downed the Cubs 6-3; Jake McCarthy [4-5, 2 HR | RC 64] also went 4-for-5 with 2 HR in Colorado's 8-6 win at St. Louis. (KC) (COL)
  • Gerrit Cole [7 IP, 2 ER, 9 K | 3.37 ERA, PAR 23] struck out 9 over 7 innings as the Yankees edged the Braves 5-4, with George Lombard Jr. [2-3, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 6] homering. (NYY)
  • Bubba Chandler [6 IP, 0 ER, 5 K | 4.26 ERA, PAR 23] tossed 6 shutout innings as the Pirates blanked the Mets 9-0, gaining ground in the NL wild (PIT)

All four division leaders lost ground on Thursday, with the Dodgers, Braves, White Sox, and Brewers each dropping games while their closest pursuers won. The Blue Jays' one-run win over the Phillies produced the day's biggest WPA swing at 4.15.

  • Cam Smith [3-4, 2 HR | RC 43] powered Houston past San Diego, further denting the Padres' wild card position. (HOU)
  • Arizona edged the Dodgers to close within 7.5 games in the NL West, while San Francisco also gained a game on Los Angeles by beating Detroit. (DODGERS)
  • Washington and New York both won to gain ground on Atlanta in the NL East, with the Nationals topping Cincinnati and the Mets beating Pittsburgh. (METS) (NATIONALS)
  • Cleveland and Minnesota both won to pull within 2.0 games of the White Sox in the AL Central, as the Cubs and Cardinals each gained on Milwaukee in the NL Central. (SOX) (CUBS) (CARDINALS)
  • Payton Tolle [6 IP, 1 ER, 14 K | 3.20 ERA, PAR 33] dominated in Boston's 13-1 rout of the Athletics, matching Tampa Bay's Drew Rasmussen [7 IP, 0 ER, 8 K | 2.76 ERA, PAR 43] atop the day's pitching leaderboard as the Rays edged Seattle. (BOS) (TB)
  • Max Fried [6.1 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 2.89 ERA, PAR 30] and the Yankees shut down Atlanta in a 3-2 win at Yankee Stadium. (NYY)
  • Texas beat Baltimore 2-1 behind a strong outing from Shane Baz [8 IP, 2 ER, 9 K | 3.77 ERA, PAR 37], and the Angels edged the Marlins 4-3 to knock Miami back in the NL wild card race. (BAL)

The AL Central race tightened dramatically as the Tigers and Twins both gained a full game on the division-leading White Sox, who barely survived an 8.80 WPA swing at Fenway. Detroit's shutout in Seattle and Minnesota's one-run win in Kansas City leave the White Sox clinging to a 3.0-game lead in the majors' most crowded division.

  • Chase Meidroth [3-5, 2 BB, 2 HR | RC 58] homered twice for the White Sox, but Boston edged Chicago 12-11 in the day's most dramatic game, gaining a half-game on Tampa Bay in the AL East. (CWS)
  • Framber Valdez [7 IP, 0 ER, 5 K | 4.18 ERA, PAR 27] tossed seven shutout innings as the Tigers blanked the Mariners 11-0, pulling within 3.5 of the AL Central lead. (DET)
  • The Twins beat the Royals 4-3 to also gain a game in the AL Central; Kansas City lost ground in the AL wild card race. (TWINS)
  • Dylan Cease [7 IP, 0 ER, 10 K | 2.28 ERA, PAR 53] struck out 10 over seven scoreless innings but the Blue Jays fell 3-2 to the Cubs, who gained a game in the NL wild card race. (TOR)
  • The Brewers beat the Pirates 5-2 behind Dustin May [6 IP, 2 ER, 5 K | 4.30 ERA, PAR 28], maintaining Milwaukee's grip on the NL Central. (MIL)
  • The Padres defeated the Diamondbacks 5-1, closing to 9.5 games behind the Dodgers in the NL West and gaining ground on Arizona. (PADRES)
  • The Braves routed the Marlins 11-3 with Matt Olson [2-3, 2 BB, 1 HR | RC 85], Mauricio Dubón [4-4, 1 BB | RC 53], and Ronald Acuña Jr. [2-5, 2 HR | RC 37] all posting big days. (ATL)
  • The Mets pounded the Guardians 13-6 behind Marcus Semien [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 34], and the Reds edged the Athletics 6-5; both winners gained a game in the NL wild card (NYM)

All three AL West contenders shifted as the Mariners and Rangers each gained a game on the division-leading Astros, who fell to the Blue Jays in the day's third-most dramatic finish. In the NL, the Diamondbacks closed to 8.0 GB of the Dodgers after Los Angeles lost a wild one at Wrigley.

  • Francisco Lindor [0-5 | RC 29] and the Mets edged the Guardians in the day's most dramatic game by WPA swing. (NYM)
  • The Nationals routed the Phillies, costing Philadelphia a game in the NL East race. (NATIONALS)
  • The Blue Jays beat the Astros to gain ground in the AL wild card chase. (JAYS)
  • The Cardinals topped the Yankees, who lost a game in the AL East. (CARDINALS)
  • Noah Cameron [8 IP, 1 ER, 9 K | 4.38 ERA, PAR 27] led all pitchers by PAR as the Royals nipped the Twins and gained on the AL Central-leading White Sox. (KC)
  • Shohei Ohtani [3-5, 2 HR] and Pete Crow-Armstrong [3-5, 2 HR | RC 92] each went deep twice in the Cubs' 7-6 win over the Dodgers. (LAD)
  • Mitch Bratt [7 IP, 0 ER, 9 K | 3.97 ERA, PAR 4] tossed seven shutout innings as Arizona routed San Diego to gain in the NL West. (AZ)
  • Bryan Woo [7 IP, 0 ER, 5 K | 4.32 ERA, PAR 32] and Sonny Gray [6 IP, 0 ER, 8 K | 2.79 ERA, PAR 38] also delivered scoreless outings in wins for Seattle and Boston. (SEA) (BOS)

The AL Central race tightened as both the Tigers and Royals picked up a game on the division-leading White Sox, who were routed at Fenway. Meanwhile, the Rays and Rockies played the day's most dramatic contest, a 9-7 Tampa Bay win at Coors Field.

  • Troy Melton [7 IP, 0 ER, 4 K | 1.58 ERA, PAR 27] and the Tigers shut out the Mariners 8-0, gaining a game in the AL Central. (DET)
  • The Royals pounded the Twins 8-2, also gaining ground in the AL Central. (TWINS)
  • Jesús Luzardo [8 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 3.37 ERA, PAR 43] dominated in the Phillies' 5-0 shutout of the Nationals, who lost ground in the NL East. (PHI)
  • Wilyer Abreu [2-4, 1 BB, 2 HR | RC 62] and Caleb Durbin [2-3, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 45] powered the Red Sox to a 14-2 rout of the White Sox. (BOS)
  • Ryan Weathers [6 IP, 0 ER, 6 K | 3.79 ERA, PAR 31] and the Yankees blanked the Cardinals 2-0 at Yankee Stadium. (NYY)
  • Luis Torrens [3-3, 1 BB, 1 HR] homered as the Mets beat the Guardians 6-2, gaining a game in the NL wild card race. (NYM)
  • The Padres routed the Diamondbacks 9-4, gaining a game on the Dodgers, who fell to Dansby Swanson [3-4, 1 HR | RC 45] and the Cubs 5-1. (CHC)
  • The Rays outlasted the Rockies 9-7 in the day's most dramatic game by WPA swing. (RAYS)

Both NL division leaders lost ground Sunday, as the Brewers and Dodgers dropped games while their pursuers won. Milwaukee fell to the Angels while the Reds and Cardinals both won, and Los Angeles was beaten at home by Boston as the Padres and Rockies also gained ground in the NL West.

  • Kyle Freeland [9 IP, 1 ER, 8 K | 6.83 ERA, PAR 3] threw a complete game as the Rockies beat the Royals 8-1, cutting into Colorado's deficit in the NL West. (COL)
  • Wilyer Abreu [2-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 59] and the Red Sox knocked off the Dodgers 8-4, pulling Boston within striking distance in the AL East. (BOS)
  • The Reds routed the Pirates 10-2 behind Tyler Stephenson [2-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 38], gaining a game on Milwaukee in the NL Central. (CIN)
  • Matthew Liberatore [6 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 4.99 ERA, PAR 14] led the Cardinals past the Blue Jays 5-1, another blow to Milwaukee's division lead and Toronto's wild card hopes. (STL)
  • The Yankees edged the Cubs 2-1 at Wrigley in one of the day's most dramatic games, gaining on the Rays in the AL East. (RAYS) (YANKEES)
  • George Kirby [7 IP, 0 ER, 3 K | 3.76 ERA, PAR 33] and the Mariners outlasted the Twins 7-6 in the day's biggest WPA swing. (SEA)
  • Jackson Merrill [2-3, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 48] homered as the Padres beat the Giants 5-4, gaining ground on the Dodgers in the NL West. (SD)
  • Brandon Nimmo [2-3, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 60] homered for Texas, but the Rangers fell to the Astros 7-3 behind Jeremy Peña [2-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 51]. (TEX)

The San Diego Padres' 6-5 win over the San Francisco Giants produced the day's biggest WPA swing at 4.50 and tightened the NL West, as San Diego, Arizona, and Colorado all gained a game on the Dodgers, who fell to Boston. In the AL Central, Detroit picked up ground on the White Sox with a win over the Athletics.

  • Drew Rasmussen [6 IP, 0 ER, 10 K | 2.92 ERA, PAR 39] led Tampa Bay past the White Sox 1-0, outdueling Chicago in a tight pitching battle. (TB)
  • Cristopher Sánchez [6 IP, 0 ER, 11 K | 2.62 ERA, PAR 54] and the Phillies shut out the Orioles 5-0 at Camden Yards. (PHI)
  • Hunter Goodman [4-5, 2 HR | RC 70] powered Colorado to a 12-6 win over Kansas City, with the Rockies gaining a game in the NL West. (COL)
  • Arizona outslugged Cleveland 12-8 behind Geraldo Perdomo [4-6, 1 HR | RC 50], gaining ground in the NL West. (AZ)
  • San Diego edged San Francisco 6-5 in the day's most dramatic finish, gaining a game on the Dodgers. (DODGERS)
  • Ceddanne Rafaela [2-4, 2 HR | RC 63] homered twice as Boston beat the Dodgers 3-2 at Dodger Stadium. (BOS)
  • Kevin McGonigle [3-4, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 70] and Framber Valdez [7 IP, 2 ER, 6 K | 4.42 ERA, PAR 23] led Detroit past the Athletics 8-6, gaining a game on the White Sox in the AL Central. (DET)
  • Martín Pérez [7 IP, 0 ER, 6 K | 3.24 ERA, PAR 24] tossed seven shutout innings as Atlanta rolled past Washington 8-3. (ATL)

Both AL East and NL West leaders lost ground as their pursuers won across the board. The Rays fell to the White Sox while Baltimore, Boston, Toronto, and New York all won, and the Dodgers dropped a 9-4 decision to Boston as Arizona, Colorado, and San Diego all gained a game in the NL West.

  • The Reds edged the Pirates 8-7 in the day's most dramatic game by WPA swing, gaining ground in the NL wild card race. (PIRATES)
  • Yainer Diaz [4-5, 1 HR | RC 24] and Isaac Paredes [2-3, 2 BB, 1 HR | RC 57] powered the Astros to an 11-2 rout of the Rangers. (HOU)
  • Will Warren [6.2 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 4.16 ERA, PAR 23] tossed 6.2 shutout innings as the Yankees blanked the Cubs 2-0 at Wrigley. (NYY)
  • Dylan Cease [6 IP, 1 ER, 7 K | 2.42 ERA, PAR 48] dominated in Toronto's 3-1 win over St. Louis, extending his AL strikeout lead. (TOR)
  • The Orioles beat the Phillies 6-4 and the Red Sox topped the Dodgers 9-4, both gaining in the AL East chase. (PHILLIES) (SOX)
  • The Tigers hammered the Athletics 13-1, gaining a game in the AL wild card race. (TIGERS)
  • Tomoyuki Sugano [6.2 IP, 1 ER, 2 K | 4.49 ERA, PAR 12] turned in 6.2 strong innings as the Rockies beat the Royals 3-1. (COL)
  • The Padres shut out the Giants 7-0 and the Marlins beat the Mets 5-2, with Miami gaining in the NL wild card race. (MARLINS) (GIANTS)

The White Sox knocked off the Yankees 2-1 in the day's most dramatic game by WPA swing, dropping New York another game back in the AL East while Tampa Bay's win over Texas kept the Rays comfortably atop the division. Meanwhile, the NL Central race tightened as both the Cubs and Reds gained half a game on the idle Brewers.

  • Sean Burke [6 IP, 0 ER, 10 K | 3.05 ERA, PAR 39] and the White Sox stifled the Yankees in a 2-1 win, the day's biggest WPA swing. (CWS)
  • The Cubs beat the Cardinals 4-2 and the Reds edged the Pirates 3-2, each gaining 0.5 games on Milwaukee in the NL Central. (CUBS) (PIRATES)
  • Tampa Bay held off Texas 3-2, while the Angels and Astros both gained half a game on the Rangers in the AL West. (RANGERS)
  • Minnesota beat Kansas City 4-3, dropping the Royals a full game in the AL Central and boosting the Twins in the AL wild card race. (ROYALS)
  • Atlanta topped Washington 5-4 and the Mets beat Miami 4-2, sending both the Nationals and Marlins a game back in the NL East. (MARLINS) (NATIONALS)
  • Daylen Lile [2-4, 2 HR | RC 52] homered twice for Washington in a losing effort, posting the day's top LWTS mark. (WSH)
  • Noah Cameron [8 IP, 0 ER, 7 K | 4.61 ERA, PAR 22] threw 8 shutout innings for Kansas City but got no decision as the Royals fell. (KC)
  • The Dodgers beat Seattle 6-2 and the Giants shut down San Diego 4-1, with Teoscar Hernández [2-3, 1 BB, 1 HR | RC 34] and Robbie Ray [6 IP, 1 ER, 6 K | 3.09 ERA, PAR 31] among the day's standouts. (LAD) (SF)

The Braves and Mets split a doubleheader at Citi Field, with Atlanta taking the nightcap 1-0 behind Chris Sale [6 IP, 0 ER, 9 K | 2.08 ERA, PAR 48] to protect their NL East lead as Miami crept a half-game closer with a win over Philadelphia. The day's most dramatic finish came in Detroit, where the Orioles edged the Tigers 10-9 in a 5.24 WPA swing that cost Detroit ground in the AL Central.

  • Orioles def. Tigers 10-9 in the day's most dramatic game, dropping Detroit further back in the AL Central. (ORIOLES)
  • Braves and Mets split at Citi Field (NYM 3-2, ATL 1-0), with Chris Sale tossing 6 shutout innings in the nightcap. (ATL)
  • Marlins def. Phillies 8-6, gaining a half-game on Atlanta in the NL East as Philadelphia lost ground. (PHILLIES)
  • Cardinals def. Cubs 3-2 behind Matthew Boyd [7 IP, 0 ER, 5 K | 3.41 ERA, PAR 18]'s 7 scoreless innings, gaining a game on Milwaukee in the NL Central. (CHC)
  • Astros def. Angels 7-4 as Yainer Diaz [4-5, 1 HR | RC 21] went 4-for-5 with a homer, pulling Houston to within 1.0 GB of Texas in the AL West. (HOU)
  • Diamondbacks def. Pirates 3-0 behind Eduardo Rodriguez [8 IP, 0 ER, 2 K | 2.49 ERA, PAR 39]'s 8 shutout innings; Royals blanked Twins 4-0 as Randy Dobnak [7 IP, 0 ER, 4 K | 1.04 ERA, PAR 10] went 7 scoreless. (AZ) (KC)
  • Giants routed Brewers 16-3 as Daniel Susac [2-4, 1 BB, 2 HR | RC 14] hit two homers; Dodgers def. Mariners 4-2 with Eric Lauer [6 IP, 0 ER, 4 K | 4.50 ERA, PAR 8] and Andy Pages [3-4, 1 HR | RC 63] leading the way. (SF) (LAD)
  • White Sox def. Yankees 6-5, Red Sox def. Athlet (YANKEES) (SOX)
